_README: Waiver ledger for tools/gate_mastery_ui.py (mastery/skill-tree UI law gate). Each key is a CURRENT known finding the gate would otherwise BLOCK; the value is why it is deferred (Will design-decision / graft-broken skillTier / golden tree / dead-ref / connector false-positive-or-screenshot). A NEW or regressed finding is NOT in here, so it fails the build. Remove a key only when its finding is genuinely fixed (the gate flags stale waivers). Golden (Occult m5 / Hunting m6) moves ALSO need occult_hunting_golden.json owner_approved_overrides. Full analysis + fix recipes: docs/reports/mastery_ui_vet_audit.md.

waivers.CONN::m1::drxbattlestandard: Will-decision (graft-broken skillTier): the grafted Club Slam family has a tier-2 base (drx_clubslam) placed ABOVE tier-7 modifiers (drx_clubslam_fissure, drx_ancestralmod) - impossible in vanilla semantics - and column 328 crams 3 families. Will must set the intended tiers before placement - mastery_ui_vet_audit.md sec 2 caveat + P3.
